item.title: 【農業】 Agri-environmental policies curb cropland degradation globally but effects vary widely
item.description: We provide global causal evidence that agri-environmental policies reduce cropland degradation. Using a dataset that links approximately 4,700 national policies to 83 million cropland observations worldwide, we showed that although agri-environmental policies are effective on average, their impacts vary substantially. item.title: 【環境】 The window to avoid locking in decades of steel emissions is closing fast
item.description: Coal-based steel plants risk locking in 60 billion tonnes of CO2 by 2070, but most of these emissions can still be avoided at moderate cost. Steel need not be hard to decarbonize: policymakers must seize the narrow window to redirect investments towards cleaner alternatives this decade.

item.title: 【環境】 Averting the steel carbon lock-in through strategic green investments
item.description: New steel capacity expansion is critical for the feasibility of climate targets, as plants operate for decades. Researchers estimate that while existing and planned plants could commit large emissions, strategic investments using climate finance can largely avert this.
